SELECT * FROM maintenance_list ml
JOIN user u ON u.id = #{userId} and #{userId} = ml.user_id
JOIN maintenance m ON m.id = #{maintenanceId} and #{maintenanceId} = ml.maintenance_id
JOIN customer c ON c.id = #{customerId} and #{customerId} = ml.customer_id
JOIN department d ON d.id = #{departmentId} and #{departmentId} = ml.department_id

SELECT m.id, m.title AS title, m.request_user AS request_user, m.description AS description, m.solve AS solve, m.type AS type, DATE_FORMAT(m.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS request_date, u.nickname AS owner, -- NULL일 경우 기본값 c.name AS customerName, ml.customer_id AS customerId, d.id AS domainId, d.dep_name AS domainName FROM maintenance m LEFT JOIN maintenance_list ml ON m.id = ml.maintenance_id LEFT JOIN user u ON ml.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN customer c ON ml.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN department d ON ml.department_id = d.id WHERE 1 = 1
AND m.id = #{id} ;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance(id, request_user, description, title, solve, request_date, type) VALUES(#{id}, #{requestUser},#{title}, #{description},#{solve},#{requestDate}, #{type});
INSERT INTO maintenance_list(user_id, maintenance_id, customer_id, department_id) VALUES(#{userId},#{newId},#{customerId},#{domainId});
mapper.update: UPDATE maintenance SET request_user=#{name}, description=#{description},solve=#{solve} WHERE id=#{id};
